title: The Still Bay and Howiesons Poort at Sibudu and Blombos: Understanding Middle Stone Age Technologies
lineage: A different and much earlier South African plant-derived tool adhesive; the source does not test whether it could be made into identical bulk rubber balls or establish direct ancestry.

passages.note: “Chemical analysis of the mastic on Sibudu segments”: conifer resin identified in the analyzed hafting residues.
